title.zh: What we know about the Revolut customer data leak
title.en: What we know about the Revolut customer data leak

current_state.zh: Attackers tricked Revolut into disclosing customer data and are allegedly leaking stolen details while demanding over 10,000 BTC (~$780M) in ransom, though Revolut has not confirmed the demand and some analysts doubt its legitimacy.
